title: Man surprises his wife with a kitten after they return from family trip
description:
Max had a plan to surprise his wife after their family trip.

During their trip, his wife fell in love with a group of stray cats.

While they couldn't bring any of those cats home, Max wanted to keep that love alive.

With the help of their three sons, Max brought home a kitten, hoping it would fill the house with the same joy they had experienced on their trip.

The moment Max's wife held the little kitten, her face lit up with pure affection.

Her love for the tiny furball was instant and undeniable.
